title: Motiq — Automation with robots and AI
description: We automate tasks with robots and AI — in agriculture, object handling and everyday work with data. Motiq, an engineering team from Zagreb.
hero.lead: We automate tasks with robots and AI. In agriculture, when sorting and moving objects, or in your digital tools. We start with what takes up your time and work with you to find a simpler way to get it done.
hero.primary: What would you like to automate?
hero.location: A small team from Zagreb. Let’s talk.
figure.title: ONE TASK, STEP BY STEP
figure.note: Animated task examples. Projects are in development.
boostStrip.label: AI-BOOST / CHALLENGE 1
boostStrip.title: Motiq selected for the ADVANCE phase.
services.title: A robot in the field. AI at your desk.
services.lead: Some tasks need a robot and a camera. Others need good software. We work on both, and connect them when it makes sense.
robotics.label: 01 / ROBOTICS
robotics.title: Robots that see and work
robotics.copy: Robotics has many uses: sorting, moving objects, field work and agriculture. We develop robotic software and computer vision around the task, the equipment and the conditions the robot needs to work in.
robotics.detail: First we look at the task, environment and equipment. We collect examples, build a prototype and test what works and what needs more work. We also use ROS / ROS2 to connect and control robots.
ai.label: 02 / ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE
ai.title: Less work at your keyboard
ai.copy: Searching documents, connecting data and repeating steps between apps. AI can help you get this done without doing it all by hand each time.
ai.detail: The assistant uses sources it is allowed to access. You can check where an answer came from and approve important actions. It can run locally or in the cloud.
cloud.label: 03 / SOFTWARE & SUPPORT
cloud.title: Keep it running
cloud.copy: Robots and AI need reliable software. We handle setup, connections and monitoring, on a local computer or in the cloud.
cloud.detail: We track errors, set up backups and make updates easier. We document the system so you can understand and maintain it.
boost.title: Tell the robot what needs doing.
boost.copy: In AI-BOOST, we are developing a way to give an agricultural robot a job in everyday language. AI should turn that instruction into a plan the robot can carry out. Our proposal was selected for the competition’s ADVANCE phase.
boost.statusCopy: We’re working on planning and checks. Testing on the target robot is still ahead.
boost.step1Copy: What the robot should do, and where.
boost.step2Copy: Using only actions that this robot can perform.
boost.step3Copy: The plan is checked. If something is not possible, the system should tell you clearly.
work.title: From the first recording to a robot task.
work.lead: These are some of the problems we’re working on. We build prototypes, collect data and learn from testing.
work.roboticsTitle: How does a robot see clear glass?
work.roboticsCopy: Glass reflects light and can blend into the background. We collect recordings and develop ways for a robot to locate an object and choose where to grasp it.
work.aiCopy: We’re working on assistants that find information and help with the next step in an app. You check the answer and decide what happens next.
demo.title: Ask instead of searching.
demo.copy: A contract, a manual or a folder full of documents. An assistant finds what you need and shows you where it’s written, so you can check the answer yourself.
demo.label: EXAMPLE
demo.question: What is the payment deadline in this agreement?
demo.answer: Payment is due within 30 days of the invoice date.
demo.note: An example of what an assistant’s answer could look like. The content is fictional.
web.label: DIGITAL TOOLS
web.title: Need a website or a small app too?
web.copy: We also build and maintain websites and practical tools that support your work.
about.title: We’re Marijan, Ivan and Petar.
about.copy: You talk to us, and build with us. We share the work, test ideas and look for a solution that fits your task.
about.marijanCopy: Builds robotic software, computer vision and AI. Connects the parts into a system and leads project conversations.
about.ivanCopy: Makes sure the software can run, be monitored and maintained — locally, on the robot or in the cloud.
about.petarCopy: Connects the robot to the equipment and tests how the system works in real conditions.
contact.title: What would you rather stop doing by hand?
contact.copy: Tell us how you do it today and what you’d like to change. You don’t need a finished specification — we can work out where to start together.
contact.direct: You can also write to us directly:
contact.location: Based in Zagreb. Open to projects worldwide.
